points: This is the more detailed account of the same event. Nicanor came into the great and holy temple and commanded the priests to deliver him the man. When they sware they could not tell where he was, he stretched out his right hand toward the temple and made an oath: if ye will not deliver me Judas as a prisoner, I will lay this temple of God even with the ground, and I will break down the altar, and erect a notable temple unto Bacchus. He swore to put another god's temple in its place.
